title: Cape Town · Chapman’s Peak and Cape Peninsula
slogan: A 115 km loop out of Hout Bay
story: Cliff road, ocean air and one of the cleanest short rides on earth. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 46 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Chapman’s Peak Drive, Noordhoek beach, Cape Point, while the fuel checkpoint and Hout Bay keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.narrative: For 38 km this is Garden Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Seven Passes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 100 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
